- **[models.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tmp/disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-013_13116_1795292913027_baseline/models.py)**:
  - Enforced `LockRecord` frozen dataclass invariants: nonempty string `resource` and `owner`; positive integer `fencing_token` (`bool` rejected); nonnegative integer `acquired_at` and `expires_at` (`bool` rejected); `expires_at > acquired_at`.
  - Defined error hierarchy with `LockConflictError(RuntimeError)`, `StaleTokenError(ValueError)`, and `OwnershipError(PermissionError)`.

- **[clock.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tmp/disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-013_13116_1795292913027_baseline/clock.py)**:
  - Supports injected callable or defaults to integer monotonic time `int(time.monotonic())`.
  - Calls source on every `now()`, strictly preserving falsy integer values such as `0` without falling back.

- **[lock_store.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tmp/disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-013_13116_1795292913027_baseline/lock_store.py)**:
  - Issued fencing tokens from a store-wide strictly increasing counter that is never reset or reused.
  - Implemented `acquire(resource, owner, ttl)` with positive int `ttl` validation and live-lock conflict detection (`expires_at > now`).
  - Implemented `renew(resource, owner, token, ttl)` verifying active lease presence (`KeyError`), token matching before owner matching (`StaleTokenError` before `OwnershipError`), and extending `expires_at` while preserving `fencing_token` and `acquired_at`.
  - Implemented `release(resource, owner, token)` enforcing identical active lease, token, and owner checks.
  - Implemented `owner(resource)` returning the active owner or `None`.

- **[coordinator.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/.gemini/AI-Lab/tmp/disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-013_13116_1795292913027_baseline/coordinator.py)**:
  - Context manager `hold(resource, owner, ttl)` yielding granted `LockRecord`.
  - Releases on context exit even if exceptions are raised inside the block.
  - Safely swallows `KeyError`, `StaleTokenError`, and `OwnershipError` on exit so expired or re-acquired leases are never erroneously overwritten or mutated.
